observations: Reviewed final revision 1 contract, spec, and hash-bound executable closure predicates against actual merged planning base. Scope is restricted to 047/046/045/A04a, evaluator-owned regressions, existing CI jobs, current planning docs and bounded new evidence/coordinator state; installed payload, sandbox behavior, completed phase and all old proof remain frozen.

Six explicit acceptance commands plus required later final closure command provide distinct intake and final stages without future-QA circularity. Red 047 requires actual original restoration invariant failure before repair, separating setup/timeout failure. Capable CI is mandatory for required sandbox/conformance acceptance; local unsupported execution cannot substitute.

Fixed nine-path source-candidate map binds actual Git tree/current bytes and genuine run head; per-job checkout SHA may be synthetic merge while executed source digests must match candidate. Exact CI/red/QA/archive paths and digest bindings are specified; initial source commit and CI remain independent of later metadata.

Pure predicates reject source/CI/QA/debt/status mismatches and distinguish intake from final. Revised evidence-gate grammar accepts actual compact/spaced success markers with named positive and missing/nonzero negative controls. Schema and predicate AST/hash checked read-only; Validator ran no verification suites and authored no acceptance tests.

review_history.evaluator_finding: Evidence-gate parser required spaced EXIT marker and rejected actual compact marker.
review_history.resolution: Revision 1 permits compact/spaced success markers with explicit positives and missing/nonzero negative controls.

final_verdict.summary: Mode A approved for revision 1: bounded independently tested maintenance is concretely testable, source/CI identity is immutable, and final closure requires actual approved proof without circular intake dependencies.
